(3) The woman is then seen in a bathroom wearing a white t-shirt and a purple hair roller, applying skincare products with her hands to her face. (4) She is shown in a living room environment drinking water from a clear glass, followed by shots of various supplement bottles from the brand YIHO POWER. (5) The woman, back in her pink outfit, speaks directly to the camera and points towards the door while gesturing excitedly. (6) A hand pours white capsules into a palm while a fluffy ragdoll cat watches curiously in the background. (7) The woman is filmed struggling to climb a set of wooden stairs, appearing physically exhausted before returning to hold up and present a white supplement bottle. (9) The woman performs an exaggerated sequence of whispering and then shouting toward the camera, ending with her winking and giving a thumbs-up while displaying a finished makeup look.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration begins over a bright, uptempo J-pop background music. Her voice is cheerful and fast-paced, articulating the importance of skincare. (2) The acoustic texture is clean, though some minor plastic rattling sounds occur as she handles supplement containers. (3) A significant vocal inflection shift occurs as the speaker emits audible panting and heavy breathing sounds to simulate physical exertion. (4) The BGM maintains a steady, synthesized beat while the speaker uses a comedic, slightly strained tone to say 'Help me' during the stair-climbing scene. (5) A new audio phase is triggered by a sudden shift to a loud whisper/ASMR style delivery, focusing on promotional details. (6) This is followed immediately by a high-arousal shout 'Hurry up!' which marks a peak in volume and intensity. (7) The track concludes with a return to a friendly, lower-arousal conversational tone as the BGM fades out gradually.
